nameOrigin: daruma doll, a traditional Japanese doll

pokedexEntries.bk: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

pokedexEntries.wh: Darumaka’s droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100° F.

pokedexEntries.x: Darumaka’s droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

pokedexEntries.or: Darumaka’s droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

pokedexEntries.y: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit.

pokedexEntries.as: When it sleeps, it pulls its limbs into its body and its internal fire goes down to 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit.

pokedexEntries.sw: It derives its power from fire burning inside its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokémon will immediately fall asleep.

pokedexEntries.sh: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it’s pushed or pulled.
